mechanism: Both drugs have sympathomimetic/cardiac effects; lisdexamfetamine increases catecholamines while mexiletine is a class IB antiarrhythmic that can potentiate cardiac arrhythmias and prolong QT interval when combined with stimulants.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, monitor cardiac function closely with ECG and vital signs, and consider alternative antiarrhythmic therapy.
